name: HMS Sovereign API
description:
The HMS Sovereign API allows you to programmatically manage your AI voice agents, phone numbers, calls, and organization settings.

## Authentication
All API requests require a valid API key passed in the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

You can find your API key in the dashboard under Settings > API Keys. Each API key is scoped to a specific organization.

## Rate Limits
- 100 requests per minute per API key
- Call control commands: 10 per minute per active call

## Errors
The API uses standard HTTP status codes. Error responses include a JSON body with an `error` field describing the issue.
